title: Campaign
description: The campaign from Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex JSON made by WolfX: changed and new characters (characters.json), decks with their cards (decks.json), story duels (storyduels.json) and their scenes (storyscripts.json), and new tutorials for Help > Tutorial (tutorials\*.json), and new campaign series (campaigns.json).

settings.title: Use picked deck in Duelist Challenges
settings.help: The challenge opponent plays the deck picked for them instead of their challenge deck. A win still clears the challenge.
